q: The email service takes the message "paid" from a work queue and finishes it. What happens to that message?
options: It stays, so analytics can read it too
It is gone, so the analytics service never sees it
It moves to the end of the queue
It is copied to every worker
why: A work queue hands a message to one worker and forgets it. For many readers of the same event, use a stream, or one queue per service.

q: In a stream with 2 partitions, the keys k0 and k1 send messages and land in different partitions. Which is read first?
options: k0, because it was sent first
k1, because it has a bigger number
There is no order between partitions, so either
They are merged into one list
why: Offsets are numbered inside each partition (both have offset 0). Order exists only inside one partition. Use the same key for events that must stay in order.

q: You need the events "created" then "paid" of one order to be read in this order. What do you do?
options: Use a random uuid as the key for each message
Use the order id as the key for all its events
Use more partitions
Send them from two different servers
why: The same key always goes to the same partition, and a partition is read in the order it was written.

q: A worker reads a message, does the work, and crashes before it commits. After the restart, what does it read?
options: Nothing, the message was read
The next message only
The same message again, so the work must be safe to repeat
An error
why: Reading does not move the bookmark. Only a commit does. That is at-least-once delivery, so the worker must be idempotent.

q: A topic has 3 partitions and a consumer group has 5 workers. How many workers do work?
why: Each partition is read by exactly one worker in the group. Two workers wait. To use more workers you need more partitions.

q: Thumbnail jobs for uploaded photos, with retries. And an audit trail of every change to an order that finance, search and analytics all read. Which tool for each?
options: Stream for both
Work queue for both
Work queue for the thumbnails, stream for the audit trail
Stream for the thumbnails, work queue for the audit trail
why: Thumbnails are jobs to do once. The audit trail is a history that many readers want, with order per key and replay.
